name: Polluted Cistern // Dim Oubliette
oracle_text:
Whenever one or more cards are put into your graveyard from your library, each opponent loses 1 life for each card type among those cards.

needs.what: Room split permanents (rule 709.5): a card with two door halves, each with its own name and mana cost ({1}{B} Polluted Cistern, {4}{B} Dim Oubliette), castable as either half; the cast half enters unlocked, the other locked; a locked door's abilities are inactive; a sorcery-speed special action pays a locked door's mana cost to unlock it; the permanent's name/cost reflect only unlocked doors
needs.why_existing_wont_do: second_face is a split/adventure/MDFC half that is cast instead of the front and then is the whole object; nothing keeps both halves on one permanent with per-half locked/unlocked state, and no special action unlocks a half

needs.what: a trigger event 'when you unlock this door' that fires when this door becomes unlocked, both when the half is cast (enters unlocked) and when unlocked later by the special action
needs.why_existing_wont_do: self_enters fires only on entering, missing a later unlock, and would fire even when this door enters locked because the other half was cast; trigger_events has no unlock event

needs.what: a batched trigger 'whenever one or more cards are put into your graveyard from your library' (mill, surveil, self-discard-from-library effects), binding the batch so the effect can read {distinct: card types among those cards} as a lose_life amount for each_opponent
needs.why_existing_wont_do: leaves_graveyard is the opposite direction, leaves_battlefield/dies with to_zones cover only permanents, and no trigger event watches a library-to-graveyard move or exposes the moved cards as a batch for the distinct value
